batches.brief: Convert tools/oracle_custbill_extract.py + jobs/sftp_ingest_poll.ksh: snapshot Oracle month-end extract (invoice_header join customer_master left join tenants, batch_no/tenant filter) plus the SFTP drop landing into ow_tp.ow_tp_custbill.custbill_feed staging table — one row per CBCUST01 65-char record, HDR/TRL rows kept tagged or dropped per spec. Snapshot load only; read-only OW_BILLING. Local plugin patches required BEFORE recon (apply to your session's plugin cache copy of skills/data-reconciliation/harness/recon/adapters.py): (1) in _uc_schema_facts change tp.grantee <> t.owner to tp.grantee <> t.table_owner (UC exposes table_owner); (2) inside _databricks_connect use sql.connect(server_hostname=host, http_path=http_path, access_token=_databricks_bearer()) for oauth-m2m (the connector's oauth_client_* kwargs drive interactive U2M and hang headless). Recon invocations: pass --target-http-path /sql/1.0/warehouses/565cd2fd713738c4 (the FULL warehouse path, not the bare id — bare id fails OpenSession). Override stale env DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH with that path for every recon and grants probe. Merge authority: the requester authorized decision mo-custbill-w1-structural (committed .migration/authorizations.json, kind merge_override) forgiving blocker class structural on unit custbill-feed (Delta informational PK + platform-side target grants). If parity is PASS and the only blocker class is structural, report merge_authority {kind: "human_override", decision_id: "mo-custbill-w1-structural"} in your structured output — the wave's merge_overrides entry covers it only when you claim that decision id. Do not widen the override: if a structural blocker lands outside custbill-feed or another class stands, report objects verbatim.
